title: PEAKDEFI Global Fund + NFT Fund + BSC PeakStaking — no unprivileged extraction; live value is holder/referrer-only or stranded
closed_reasons: Admin/upgrade entry points (changeProxyAdmin, developerInitiateUpgrade, migrateOwnedContractsToNextVersion, transferAssetToNextVersion, changeDeveloperFeeAccount/Rate, listKyber/CompoundToken) resolve to empty fallbacks in the live implementation chain - callable but no-ops; state verified unchanged on fork
deposit and withdraw are both priced at NAV = totalFundsInUSDC/shareSupply; phase transitions only subtract fees, so round trips are a net loss (measured 1000 USDC in -> 978.19 USDC total return)
nextPhase() is permissionless but pays the caller nothing (NEXT_PHASE_REWARD=1e18 is never paid)
referral commissions cannot be farmed: sybil A-refers-B farming is net-negative (A +7.38 USDC cash vs B -27.35 USDC NAV dilution on a 2k position)
manager registration registerWithUSDC() reverts; all 3 REP holders have commission=0 for every cycle and redeemCommission pays 0

BSC PeakStaking mint cap exhausted: mintedPeakTokens=27499999999919103 vs cap 27500000000000000 (headroom 0.000809 PEAK); any >=1 PEAK stake reverts before minting; all 4 PEAK mint caps >=99.4% consumed
BSC staking withdraw(stakeIdx) is staker-only and there is no admin/withdraw-all function

caveats: Fund implementation is unverified; behaviour established by debug_traceCall + fork simulation of every tested path, not by source review
Referral-pool H-O amounts are claimable only during the sell phase (next global sell window opens when anyone calls nextPhase() after 2026-11-04)
H-O amounts assume entitled parties still control their keys; PEAK leg is not realisable at mark given ~4k USD DEX liquidity
Manager-pool commission formula is opaque; S classification is based on exhaustive testing of every redemption entry point with all REP holders
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from PEAKDEFI: the two Ethereum funds' $110,234 USDC and BSC staking pool are reachable only by entitled share holders/referrers/stakers (H-O $107,066), the admin surface is a no-op, all PEAK mint caps are exhausted, and $13,543 of manager commissions has no claim path (S).
